generation.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit target: the supplied CT Life five-friend campaign ensemble image.
Change only the rendering language. Transform the entire ensemble from fashion-photograph realism into unmistakably authored, premium stylized 3D GAME KEY ART, with carefully sculpted character models and designed materials.
Keep invariant: exactly the same five characters, their identities and skin colors, poses, gestures, interactions, outfits and outfit colors, closed laptop and phone, lavender bench and low sculptural plinth, camera viewpoint, asymmetrical group arrangement, framing, whole bodies and feet, lighting direction, and genuinely transparent alpha background. Do not redesign the CT logo; there is no logo in this artwork.
Rendering target: sophisticated adult life-simulation game characters. Deliberately simplified, clean sculpted facial planes with soft expressive stylized eyes and mouths; attractive adult proportions and a slightly toy-like modeled finish, never chibi or children. Hair must become art-directed sculpted locks/clumps with clean shapes rather than individually photographed flyaway hairs. Fabric must have designed broad folds, simplified seams and clean shader surfaces rather than photographic weave or dense wrinkles. Skin uses soft stylized subsurface shading rather than real portrait pores. Hands, shoes, jewelry, laptop, phone and the friendly original frog must all have the same coherent modeled 3D key-art treatment. Keep the quality exceptionally polished and tactile, with matte fabric/ceramic materials and restrained glossy accents, studio softness and golden rimlight.
Avoid: photoreal people, photo-retouch appearance, portrait photography, uncanny mannequins, chibi heads, flattened 2D illustration, extra characters/props, charts, text, logos, watermark, new backdrop or opaque floor. Preserve actual transparency. Produce a new version; the old image is not being replaced.

inspection.comparison: V2 replaces photographic hair/fabric/skin detail with sculpted locks, broader designed folds, soft modeled faces and coherent stylized materials. Original five-character group, outfits/colors, props, gestures, bench/plinth and whole-body composition remain substantially aligned, not pixel-identical.
inspection.recommendation: V2 is the stronger game-key-art candidate for root's live page review.
inspection.limits: Not user-approved, not a gameplay capture or playable character model. No existing logo edited. All v1 outputs and the hero-ensemble.webp alias retained unchanged.
